mapper.sql: select id, refund_no, source_type, source_id, owner_type, owner_id, member_id, merchant_id, paid_amount, refund_amount, status, reason, reject_reason, reviewer_id, reviewed_at, created_by_user_id, adjustment_created, idempotency_key, del_flag, payout_status, payout_method, payout_receipt_url, payout_handler_id, payout_handled_at, payout_reviewer2_id, payout_reviewed2_at, payout_remark, payout_lease_token, payout_lease_owner, payout_lease_expires_at, create_time, update_time, platform_takeover_at from refund_application

choose.when: order by platform_takeover_at is null asc, platform_takeover_at desc, id desc

mapper.select: where source_type = 'registration' and source_id = #{registrationId} and del_flag = 0 order by id for update
mapper.insert: insert into refund_application (refund_no, source_type, source_id, owner_type, owner_id, member_id, merchant_id, paid_amount, refund_amount, status, reason, adjustment_created, idempotency_key, created_by_user_id, del_flag, payout_status, create_time) values (#{refundNo}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{memberId}, #{merchantId}, #{paidAmount}, #{refundAmount}, #{status}, #{reason}, 0, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createdByUserId}, #{delFlag}, #{payoutStatus}, now())
mapper.update: update refund_application set status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, update_time = #{reviewedAt} where id = #{id} and status = 0 and del_flag = 0

update refund_application set payout_status = #{payoutStatus}, payout_remark = #{payoutRemark}, payout_lease_token = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0 and (payout_status is null or payout_status in (0, 2, 5, 6))

update refund_application set payout_status = 6, payout_remark = '原路退款派发中', payout_lease_token = #{leaseToken}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 1 and del_flag = 0 and ( payout_status is null or payout_status = 5
or (payout_status = 6 and COALESCE(update_time, create_time) < NOW(3) - INTERVAL #{staleMinutes} MINUTE) )

update refund_application set payout_status = 5, payout_remark = #{payoutRemark}, payout_lease_token = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0 and payout_status = 6 and payout_lease_token = #{leaseToken}

update refund_application set payout_status = #{payoutStatus}, payout_remark = #{payoutRemark}, payout_lease_token = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0 and payout_status = 6 and payout_lease_token = #{leaseToken}
update refund_application set refund_no = #{refundNo}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0 and (refund_no is null or refund_no = '' or refund_no = #{refundNo})

update refund_application set payout_lease_owner = #{handlerId}, payout_lease_token = #{leaseToken}, payout_lease_expires_at = NOW(3) + INTERVAL #{leaseMinutes} MINUTE, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0 and payout_status = 2 and ( payout_lease_token is null or (payout_lease_owner = #{handlerId} and payout_lease_expires_at is not null and payout_lease_expires_at < now()) )

update refund_application set payout_lease_owner = null, payout_lease_token = null, payout_lease_expires_at = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0 and payout_status = 2 and payout_lease_owner = #{handlerId} and payout_lease_token = #{leaseToken} and payout_lease_expires_at is not null

update refund_application set payout_lease_owner = #{handlerId}, payout_lease_token = #{leaseToken}, payout_lease_expires_at = NOW(3) + INTERVAL #{leaseMinutes} MINUTE, payout_remark = #{payoutRemark}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0 and payout_status = 2 and payout_lease_owner is not null and payout_lease_owner <> #{handlerId} and payout_lease_expires_at is not null and payout_lease_expires_at < now()

update refund_application set payout_status = 3, payout_method = #{payoutMethod}, payout_receipt_url = #{payoutReceiptUrl}, payout_handler_id = #{handlerId}, payout_handled_at = #{handledAt}, payout_remark = #{payoutRemark}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0 and payout_status = 2 and payout_lease_owner = #{handlerId} and payout_lease_token = #{leaseToken} and payout_lease_expires_at is not null and payout_lease_expires_at >= now()

update refund_application set payout_status = 4, payout_reviewer2_id = #{reviewer2Id}, payout_reviewed2_at = #{reviewed2At}, payout_lease_owner = null, payout_lease_expires_at = null, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0 and payout_status = 3 and (payout_handler_id is null or payout_handler_id != #{reviewer2Id})
mapper.select: where del_flag = 0 and payout_status in (2, 3) order by id asc
where refund_no = #{refundNo} and del_flag = 0 order by id desc limit 1
where del_flag = 0 and (payout_status = 0 or (payout_status in (5, 6) and status = 1)) and COALESCE(update_time, create_time) < DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE) order by id asc limit 200

select max(id) from refund_application where del_flag = 0 and (payout_status = 0 or (payout_status in (5, 6) and status = 1)) and COALESCE(update_time, create_time) < DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)

select count(1) from refund_application r left join cms_activity a on a.id = r.owner_id where r.del_flag = 0 and ((r.owner_type = 2 and a.topic_id = #{topicId}) or (r.owner_type = 1 and r.owner_id = #{topicId})) and (r.status = 0 or (r.status = 1 and (r.payout_status is null or r.payout_status not in (1, 4))))
select count(1) from refund_application where del_flag = 0 and payout_status in (2, 3)
select count(1) from refund_application where del_flag = 0 and status = 1 and payout_status in (5, 6) and COALESCE(update_time, create_time) < DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE)
select id from refund_application where del_flag = 0 and payout_status in (2, 3) order by id asc limit 20

select id from refund_application where del_flag = 0 and status = 1 and payout_status in (5, 6) and COALESCE(update_time, create_time) < DATE_SUB(now(), INTERVAL #{minutes} MINUTE) order by id asc limit 20
